children: FLYNAS COMPANY SJSC - TO BUY 10% EQUITY INTEREST IN SWISSPORT SAUDI ARABIA
FLYNAS COMPANY SJSC-  DEAL TOTAL CONSIDERATION OF USD 13.3 MILLION
FLYNAS COMPANY SJSC - SIGNS GROUND HANDLING AGREEMENT FOR AVIATION HANDLING SERVICES
FLYNAS: FIVE-YEAR GROUND HANDLING AGREEMENT  TO PROVIDE GROUND HANDLING SERVICES AT ALL COMMERCIAL AIRPORTS IN KSA
FLYNAS - ANNUAL PURCHASE VOLUME UNDER GROUND HANDLING EXPECTED TO BE ABOUT 5% OF CO REVENUE
FLYNAS: AGREEMENT WILL BE EFFECTIVE FROM 06 MARCH 2027 UNTIL 05 MARCH 2032 AND MAY BE RENEWED FOR ADDITIONAL FIVE-YEAR TERM
FLYNAS -  IN ADDITION TO A MINIMAL VARIABLE EQUITY CONSIDERATION CALCULATED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE MECHANISM SET OUT IN THE AGREEMENTS
FLYNAS- SHA ALSO GRANTS FLYNAS CALL OPTION TO ACQUIRE ADDITIONAL 10% EQUITY INTEREST IN SWISSPORT SAUDI ARABIA UPON RENEWAL OF GROUND HANDLING DEAL
FLYNAS - TRANSACTION WILL BE FINANCED FROM THE COMPANY’S INTERNAL RESOURCES
